r.age_min IS NULL AND r.age_max IS NULL AND #{cond.age} IS NOT NULL AND CONCAT_WS(' ', r.name, r.applicant) REGEXP '어르신|노인|경로|아동|영유아|유아|어린이|신생아|영아|청소년|청년' AND NOT (CONCAT_WS(' ', r.name, r.applicant) REGEXP '어르신|노인|경로' AND #{cond.age} >= 60) AND NOT (CONCAT_WS(' ', r.name, r.applicant) REGEXP '아동|영유아|유아|어린이|신생아|영아' AND #{cond.age} <= 18) AND NOT (CONCAT_WS(' ', r.name, r.applicant) REGEXP '청소년' AND #{cond.age} BETWEEN 9 AND 24) AND NOT (CONCAT_WS(' ', r.name, r.applicant) REGEXP '청년' AND #{cond.age} BETWEEN 19 AND 39)

( CASE WHEN (r.age_min IS NOT NULL OR r.age_max IS NOT NULL) AND #{cond.age} IS NOT NULL AND #{cond.age} BETWEEN COALESCE(r.age_min, 0) AND COALESCE(r.age_max, 200) THEN 3 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.dong_codes IS NOT NULL AND #{cond.dong} IS NOT NULL AND FIND_IN_SET(#{cond.dong}, r.dong_codes) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.household_types IS NOT NULL AND () THEN 2 ELSE 0 END 0 + CASE WHEN r.income_rank IS NOT NULL AND #{cond.incomeRank} BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND #{cond.incomeRank} <= r.income_rank THEN 2 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.disability = 'Y' AND #{cond.disability} = 'Y' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.nationality IS NOT NULL AND r.nationality = #{cond.nationality} THEN 3 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN r.edu_work IS NOT NULL AND () THEN 2 ELSE 0 END 0 ) AS score, /* 추천 이유: 일치 태그 CSV */ CONCAT_WS(',', CASE WHEN (r.age_min IS NOT NULL OR r.age_max IS NOT NULL) AND #{cond.age} IS NOT NULL AND #{cond.age} BETWEEN COALESCE(r.age_min, 0) AND COALESCE(r.age_max, 200) THEN 'AGE' END, CASE WHEN r.dong_codes IS NOT NULL AND #{cond.dong} IS NOT NULL AND FIND_IN_SET(#{cond.dong}, r.dong_codes) THEN 'DONG' END,
CASE WHEN r.household_types IS NOT NULL AND () THEN 'HOUSEHOLD' END,
CASE WHEN r.income_rank IS NOT NULL AND #{cond.incomeRank} BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND #{cond.incomeRank} <= r.income_rank THEN 'INCOME' END, CASE WHEN r.disability = 'Y' AND #{cond.disability} = 'Y' THEN 'DISABILITY' END, CASE WHEN r.nationality IS NOT NULL AND r.nationality = #{cond.nationality} THEN 'NATIONALITY' END,
CASE WHEN r.edu_work IS NOT NULL AND () THEN 'EDUWORK' END,
NULL ) AS matched_csv, /* 확인 필요 태그 CSV */ CONCAT_WS(',', CASE WHEN (r.age_min IS NOT NULL OR r.age_max IS NOT NULL) AND (#{cond.age} IS NULL OR #{cond.age} = COALESCE(r.age_min, 0) - 1 OR #{cond.age} = COALESCE(r.age_max, 200) + 1) THEN 'AGE' END, CASE WHEN r.dong_codes IS NOT NULL AND #{cond.dong} IS NULL THEN 'DONG' END,
CASE WHEN r.household_types IS NOT NULL THEN 'HOUSEHOLD' END,
CASE WHEN r.income_rank IS NOT NULL AND (#{cond.incomeRank} = 0 OR (#{cond.incomeRank} = 4 AND r.income_rank = 4)) THEN 'INCOME' END, CASE WHEN r.income_uncertain = 'Y' AND r.income_rank IS NOT NULL AND #{cond.incomeRank} BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND #{cond.incomeRank} <= r.income_rank THEN 'INCOME_DETAIL' END, CASE WHEN r.disability = 'Y' AND #{cond.disability} = 'U' THEN 'DISABILITY' END, CASE WHEN r.nationality = 'K' AND #{cond.nationality} = 'F' THEN 'NATIONALITY' END,
CASE WHEN r.edu_work IS NOT NULL THEN 'EDUWORK' END,
CASE WHEN THEN 'AGE_HINT' END, CASE WHEN r.uncertain_note IS NOT NULL THEN 'NOTE' END ) AS need_check_csv

AND r.edu_work IS NULL AND (r.edu_work IS NULL OR )
mapper.select:
SELECT m.* FROM ( SELECT r.*, ,
FROM resource r LEFT JOIN resource_i18n i ON i.resource_id = r.resource_id AND i.lang = #{lang} WHERE r.status = 'A'
AND r.category = #{category} ) m ORDER BY m.data_base_date DESC, m.score DESC, (m.nationality = 'F') DESC, (CASE WHEN m.need_check_csv = '' THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH(m.need_check_csv) - LENGTH(REPLACE(m.need_check_csv, ',', '')) + 1 END) ASC, m.data_base_date DESC

SELECT r.*, , /* 불일치 태그 CSV (상세 판정표 전용 — 목록에서는 WHERE로 제외되는 행들) */ CONCAT_WS(',', CASE WHEN (r.age_min IS NOT NULL OR r.age_max IS NOT NULL) AND #{cond.age} IS NOT NULL AND (#{cond.age} < COALESCE(r.age_min, 0) - 1 OR #{cond.age} > COALESCE(r.age_max, 200) + 1) THEN 'AGE' END, CASE WHEN r.dong_codes IS NOT NULL AND #{cond.dong} IS NOT NULL AND NOT FIND_IN_SET(#{cond.dong}, r.dong_codes) THEN 'DONG' END,
CASE WHEN r.household_types IS NOT NULL THEN 'HOUSEHOLD' END,
CASE WHEN r.household_types IS NOT NULL AND NOT () THEN 'HOUSEHOLD' END,
CASE WHEN r.income_rank IS NOT NULL AND #{cond.incomeRank} BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND #{cond.incomeRank} > r.income_rank AND NOT (#{cond.incomeRank} = 4 AND r.income_rank = 4) THEN 'INCOME' END, CASE WHEN r.disability = 'Y' AND #{cond.disability} = 'N' THEN 'DISABILITY' END, CASE WHEN r.nationality = 'F' AND #{cond.nationality} = 'K' THEN 'NATIONALITY' END,
CASE WHEN r.edu_work IS NOT NULL THEN 'EDUWORK' END,
CASE WHEN r.edu_work IS NOT NULL AND NOT () THEN 'EDUWORK' END,
NULL ) AS mismatched_csv,
FROM resource r LEFT JOIN resource_i18n i ON i.resource_id = r.resource_id AND i.lang = #{lang} WHERE r.resource_id = #{id}
